example.question: What is the total horses record for each farm, sorted ascending?
example.expected_query: SELECT Total_Horses FROM farm ORDER BY Total_Horses ASC

spider_schema.city:
CREATE TABLE "city" (
City_ID number,
Official_Name text,
Status text,
Area_km_2 number,
Population number,
Census_Ranking text,
)
spider_schema.farm:
CREATE TABLE "farm" (
Farm_ID number,
Year number,
Total_Horses number,
Working_Horses number,
Total_Cattle number,
Oxen number,
Bulls number,
Cows number,
Pigs number,
Sheep_and_Goats number,
)
spider_schema.farm_competition:
CREATE TABLE "farm_competition" (
Competition_ID number,
Year number,
Theme text,
Host_city_ID number,
Hosts text,
)
spider_schema.competition_record:
CREATE TABLE "competition_record" (
Competition_ID number,
Farm_ID number,
Rank number,
)
